text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Because you standing there carried 
yourself with such magnificent dignity.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I saw them overlapping. —The Tiara 
Umamusume I had always looked up to."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"That radiance. That elegance. That 
strength. I saw everything I yearned for 
in you."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Yet you aren't just someone I admire. You 
are my—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...!! —I have to go...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Would she make it to the goal? Not a 
single ounce of doubt crossed her mind.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am fast. Just as you praised me 
to be."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am strong. Strong enough that 
you chased after me for so long."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Because... I am your—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Aaaaahhhhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I won't lose...!! I'm never yielding...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Even if my breath gives out, push 
forward! Even if my legs feel like lead, 
keep driving into the ground...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: We are...!! The absolute, beeeeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah... Aah...! —Heart-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—It's Daring Heart! To think the winner is 
Daring Heart!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Are you watching, rivals!? No one can 
break her spirit! This is the Queen! 
Daring Heart!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I WON!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart's scream, packed with all her 
emotions, echoed high into the clear 
autumn sky—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't lose, I...! I actually won...!
choice_data_list: No one can make you bow your head
No one can make you bow your head

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Even if time pursues me—even 
if oblivion draws near...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm here! Our youth—will never 
end!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have this heart! I can run... 
wherever, forever!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Heart-san...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...Heart-san! Heart-san...!!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Craft...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Cesario... I...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I want to... run too...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I want to stand there! Because... I—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Because we're rivals...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, those eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's the brilliance of the rival I've 
always admired.
choice_data_list: Should I go call them over?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine. ...Right here is fine.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Heart-san! I'm going to run...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best... I won't give up, so...! 
So...—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Will you wait for me!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ――Of course!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll wait, for as long as it takes. I'm 
not going to leave this spot.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: When tired, there is someone to lean on.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—I will keep surviving on this turf... 
and wait for you!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah! —It's a promise...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san's youth is... truly 
dazzling—shining with pure clarity."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...I really do love your heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—There are plenty of ways to learn. Even 
if it's not directly... you can learn just 
by watching.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I will make the strength of your 
heart... my very own... Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, the shadow of a bird—swept 
across the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, that bird just now. Do you think 
it was some kind of omen?
choice_data_list: ...If so, what kind of hint would that be?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Well... Right, it must be like this!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's blessing our future. —Follow your 
"heart"!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Or something like that♪
